Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Charlie is white.

Predicates:
Kind($x, bool) ::: Is x kind?
Big($x, bool) ::: Is x big?
Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?
White($x, bool) ::: Is x white?
Red($x, bool) ::: Is x red?
Rough($x, bool) ::: Is x rough?
Quiet($x, bool) ::: Is x quiet?

Facts:
Kind(Anne, True) ::: Anne is kind.
Big(Charlie, False) ::: Charlie is not big.
Green(Charlie, False) ::: Charlie is not green.
White(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is white.
Big(Erin, True) ::: Erin is big.
Green(Erin, True) ::: Erin is green.
White(Erin, True) ::: Erin is white.
Green(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is green.
Kind(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is kind.
Quiet(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is quiet.
Red(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is red.
White(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is white.

Rules:
Big(Erin, True) && Red(Erin, True) >>> Kind(Erin, True) ::: If Erin is big and Erin is red then Erin is kind.
Rough($x, True) >>> Green($x, True) ::: All rough things are green.
Kind($x, True) >>> Green($x, True) ::: If something is kind then it is green.
Quiet($x, True) && Green($x, True) >>> Big($x, True) ::: Quiet, green things are big.
Rough($x, True) && Green($x, True) >>> Red($x, True) ::: If something is rough and green then it is red.
Green($x, True) >>> Rough($x, True) ::: If something is green then it is rough.
Red(Erin, True) >>> Green(Erin, True) ::: If Erin is red then Erin is green.
Red($x, True) && Rough($x, True) >>> Quiet($x, True) ::: All red, rough things are quiet.
Quiet($x, True) && Red($x, False) >>> White($x, False) ::: If something is quiet and not red then it is not white.

Query:
White(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is white.
